# Housekeeping: compressor

## Authorized scope and smallest closable slice

Review the complete `crates/compressor` Cargo package and its tests. Deliver practical, behavior-preserving cleanup in this package, or an evidenced no-change verdict when existing choices earn their cost. Cover all five user requests: repeated code/LoC; load-bearing test purposes; avoidable copies; applicable micro SIMD; and data structures that cap efficiency. The user requests two GPT-6.1 Sol xhigh agents concurrently; this overrides the default Terra implementation model for this workflow. Root Sol owns briefing, adversarial review, exact-path checkpoints, integration and remote synchronization.

## Frozen boundaries

Existing public APIs, feature behavior, canonical/wire identities, arithmetic order and per-lane rendered bits, latency/tail, link modes, smoothing and NaN/denormal rules remain contractual. Zero render allocations/frees, locks, I/O or syscalls; no runtime native ISA dispatch. Retain scalar tails, 4-lane Wasm/NEON and x86 AVX2/FMA. Preserve all feature and target configurations. Do not expand another open issue or change DSP algorithms. Read current related issue bodies before touching their subject; discoveries that require architecture or product decisions become bounded follow-ups and final owner questions.

## Implementation and test-value decisions

Prefer deleting or consolidating repetition to adding abstractions that increase total complexity. Assess every existing test or a clearly named homogeneous family by its plausible unique defect; remove trivial, redundant or obsolete cases only after identifying the surviving behavioral gate. Keep independent numeric/oracle, fault, allocation, queue, boundary and target tests. Add/rewrite tests only for a concrete uncovered defect, and state which plausible defect no existing test catches. No prose/source-grep tests, new bit-digest pins or exact resource-byte pins. Copies needed for ownership, snapshots or atomic admission stay unless the same semantics are proved with less work. Data structure changes must preserve deterministic order and bounded realtime work. Inspect applicable hot loops and generated code before claiming additional SIMD; recursive/stateful dependencies alone do not justify changing arithmetic.

## Objective gates and evidence

- Read all production and test files in this package; record concise findings for each of the five requests, concrete changed/deferred locations, and load-bearing test families with retained coverage for deletions.
- Run focused locked package tests and affected feature configurations; use existing downstream/RT/differential gates proportional to the changed contract. Check formatting and package clippy with warnings denied. Relevant Wasm and AArch64 compile checks are required for changed product code; record limitations candidly.
- Changes to DSP arithmetic or hot state need existing independent numeric and scalar/SIMD gates plus one-time base/head evidence when needed; no permanent comparison against the old implementation. Existing research remains the algorithm authority; no new algorithm or listening claim is authorized.
- Benchmarks are optional and descriptive. Any timed measurement freezes its workload/validator, passes zero-workload preflight, and runs exactly one invocation with one warmup/two measured rounds. No timing optimization loop, performance percentage or unsupported sound-quality claim.
- Root conducts one adversarial verdict per coherent attempt, at most five total attempts. Every new/rewritten test gets its unique-defect sentence in that verdict. No-change audits require the same five-axis review, not manufactured edits.
- Stop after a coherent compiling, focused-green tranche; root commits exact owned paths before further edits. Keep edits within `crates/compressor` and this numbered spec. Independent crates use separate worktrees. Root pushes promptly and updates this GitHub issue with evidence; close only after PASS and evidence upstream, verifying remote state. Merge through the required qualification check and remove clean completed worktrees.

### Attempt 1 — worker A, GPT-6.1 Sol xhigh, 2026-10-01

Read all 30 original package files: manifest, six source modules, all integration/support files, mutation history and the timing example. Read related #889, #1019 and #349 boundaries; optional-slot handling, AArch64 min/max qualification and algorithm/kernel optimization remain separate. Product checkpoint `8459261a` was integrated/pushed by root at `3c6d7794` before remaining gates. No benchmark, new generator, DSP expression, feature/API or G5 corpus/pin change.

**Five axes.** Repetition: replace the verbatim historical ramping/settled splitter with the current one-frame scheduling reference; delete two historical #1006 pins and demonstrated weaker/vacuous tests. Test value: retained purposes and deletion survivors below; no new test. Copies: design directly from the seven default values, consume lane-test input planes, compare PCM words in place, move consumed clean inputs, extend padding output directly and sort immutable point lists once rather than once per block. SIMD: settled/ramping two-pass targets, lane-wide masked ramps, reductions and link/output selects already use `Lane`; scalar/tails and W4/W8 stay intact. Source inspection found no further simple SIMD change that preserves the frozen operation order; no new codegen or speed claim. Structures: fixed coefficient/ramp/pending arrays and 32-frame scratch earn bounded work, deterministic traversal and allocation freedom; retain them. Raw corpus case comparison removes hashing and a second render per case, while retaining 98,304 bytes of ordered case words plus one 24,576-byte sorting copy (descriptive test-memory tradeoff).

Production changes are the redundant seed-array removal and rate-coefficient documentation: NaN/nonpositive time or zero rate is instantaneous, positive infinity at a positive rate freezes. The expression is unchanged. Test comments now acknowledge the recorded GREEN Average-subnormal shortcut and signed-zero predicate mutations; current equivalence/state scenarios remain. Package reduction: **993 lines** (Rust −1003, manifest −2, mutation-history notice +12); lock −1 compressor dependency row, no version/checksum/other package changes. An initially minimal-context generated lock patch matched builtins; inspection caught it, explicit full-package context restored builtins and removed only compressor's row before the first locked candidate run.

**Deleted coverage and survivors.**

- `scenario_1006_ramping_prefix_is_pinned` and `ramping_prefix_scenario`: historical implementation-output digests. Current frame-law grid/random compares full coefficients/ramps, remaining=0/current≠target holds and active remaining=1..64 restores, ragged prefixes, reset/discontinuity and hostile recovery; `ramps`/`native_points` retain repeated per-lane/channel retargets, exact snaps and attack/release return; `payload` retains both reset and transactional restore behavior; `mono_collapse`/`randomized` retain handoff and witness behavior; private/public padding retain clone/pad/report/fault isolation. Every #1006 RED row in the existing mutation record already names surviving grid/random catches. No unique scenario contract was found.
- `future_main_and_sidechain_suffixes_cannot_change_the_prefix`: its 256-frame asserted prefix receives two identical 128-frame calls in both arms; suffixes are unavailable until later calls, so it cannot detect within-block future reads. Current per-frame Main/Silent/Sidechain differential, real nine-partition witnesses and all-rate sample-zero gates defend causal scheduling.
- `a_ramp_that_finishes_mid_block_is_invisible_to_the_partition`: threshold-only 128-versus-64 subset; `partition` checks these boundaries plus seven others with all seven parameters, both channels and state, including native bank and connected sidechain.
- `causal_processing_starts_at_sample_zero`: single-rate impulse subset; surviving all-launch-rate scalar/bank active and identity impulse gate checks the same zero-latency seam, with independent recurrence/curve tests defending its positive compressed value.

### Root adversarial review — attempt 1

Root adversarial verdict: PASS for the frozen housekeeping scope. Root reviewed every changed production/test hunk, the retired causality/scenario bodies and retained frame-law generator, restore/reset/partition/sample-zero owners. The only production change borrows the existing seven defaults directly; rate-coefficient arithmetic is unchanged. The current per-frame scheduling oracle shares physical primitives openly, while independent f64 curve/recurrence tests remain. Debug/release, strict Clippy, realtime child, supported-target compilation and package-anchored lock evidence satisfy the proportional gates. No runtime speed or arbitrary target execution claim.

Test value: the rewritten mixed/compressing grids and three randomized widths expose chunk/prefix offset, lane-hold/scatter, coefficient-ramp and recovery-state defects over hostile main/sidechain inputs, retargets, resets, restores and ragged block endings; their generator reach, rather than exclusive catches, earns these differentials. The merged corpus gate rejects nonfinite, silent/repetitive or duplicated dispatch cases that the single-owned cross-target equality pins cannot prove nonvacuous. The bank/scalar lane comparison still detects lane/channel parameter leakage at every rendered frame while consuming owned inputs. The fast/forced-slow fixed-point comparison now rejects a missing returning tone in its own nonvacuity assertion; the removed standalone invocation repeated that render. The padding iterator retains every PCM/report/state word comparison and removes only an intermediate vector. Remaining changed tests only move consumed inputs, hoist immutable sorting or correct names/comments; no defended behavior was removed. All seven deletions have the documented stronger survivor; no new test or permanent historical oracle was added.
